common.02: alt="Tambarin Rethinking Africa with Dr. Damola"
about.002: >Ba wai kawai a yi nazarin Afirka ba. Dole Afirka ta yi magana, ta yi tunani, ta ƙirƙira kuma ta yanke shawara.
about.007: >Dandalin bincike, kafafen yaɗa labarai da ilimantar da jama’a wanda ya ɗora Afirka a tsakiya
about.008: >Rethinking Africa with Dr. Damola yana nazarin ra’ayoyi, tsare-tsare da zaɓuɓɓukan da ke siffanta ci gaban Afirka. Ta hanyar sharhin da ya dogara da bincike, ba da labari irin na fim mai bayani, hira, tattaunawar jama’a da ayyukan ƙirƙira, dandalin yana nazarin yadda ’yan Afirka ke fahimtar kansu, ke ilimantar da ’ya’yansu, ke tsara cibiyoyinsu, ke adana iliminsu da kuma ke hasashen makomarsu.
about.009: >Afirka ba ta rasa basira ba. Ƙalubalenta shi ne yawancin basirarta ba a gane ta ba, ba a inganta ta ba, ba a kafa mata cibiyoyi ba, ba a ba ta kuɗi ba, kuma ba a mayar da ita ƙarfin gamayya yadda ya kamata ba.
about.010: >Don haka dandalin ya wuce kawai bayyana matsalolin Afirka. Yana tambayar yadda aka haifar da waɗannan matsaloli, me ke ɗorewar da su, wane ilimi aka yi watsi da shi da kuma waɗanne hanyoyi na zahiri za a iya ginawa.
about.011: >Cikakkiyar takardar ra’ayin shirin tana samuwa don saukarwa: Takardar Ra’ayin Shirin (PDF).
about.013: >Ana yawan gabatar da Afirka da kalmomin rikici, talauci, cin hanci, dogaro da kasawa. Ko da yake waɗannan ƙalubale gaskiya ne, ba su ba da cikakken labarin Afirka ba. A faɗin nahiyar, ilimi mai daraja yana ɓoye a cikin al’ummomi, sana’o’i, harsuna, al’adu, cibiyoyin gargajiya da kuma rayuwar talakawa.
about.014: >A lokaci guda, tsarin ilimi da na ci gaba na iya koya wa ’yan Afirka su yaba da abin da ya fito daga waje, alhali suna shakkar abin da ya taso daga muhallinsu. An kafa Rethinking Africa ne domin ƙalubalantar wannan rashin daidaiton tunani.
about.015: >Manufar ba ita ce ƙawata tarihin Afirka ba, ko ƙin ilimin da ya fito daga sauran sassan duniya. Manufar ita ce ƙarfafa ikon Afirka na mu’amala da duniya cikin ƙwarin gwiwa, ta ɗauki ilimin duniya cikin hikima, kuma ta shiga ba tare da ta bar muryarta, ƙwaƙwalwarta ko ’yancinta ba.
about.016: >Bincike mai zurfi da aka kawo wa jama’a
about.017: >Rethinking Africa tana mayar da bincike mai zurfi da ainihin rayuwar ’yan Afirka zuwa ilimin jama’a mai sauƙin samu: maƙalolin bidiyo bisa bincike, hira da malamai, ƙwararru da masu riƙe da ilimin al’umma, fina-finai masu bayani da labarai daga fage, gajerun bidiyoyin bayani, maƙaloli da nazarin manufofi, labaran ƙirƙira da kasuwancin Afirka, da tattaunawa tsakanin tsararraki, dattawa da matasa.
about.018: >Kowane labari yana farawa da tambaya. Me ya sa ilimin Afirka wani lokaci ke raba mutane da muhallinsu? Me ya sa manyan ayyukan Afirka ke ci gaba da dogaro da ƙwararru daga waje? Me ya sa matasa sukan ƙi sana’o’i da ilimin tsararrakin da suka gabata? Ta yaya ilimin gargajiya zai zama kimiyya, masana’antu da kasuwanci na zamani? Ta yaya Afirka za ta zama ta zamani ba tare da ta zama kwafin wata wayewa ba?
about.021: >Ana ɗaukar Afirka a matsayin halastacciyar cibiyar ilimi, fassara da damarmaki.
about.023: >Ana goyon bayan hujjoji da bincike, bayanai, tarihi, ƙwarewar sana’a da shaidar al’umma.
about.025: >Dandalin yana fuskantar gadon mulkin mallaka, rashin daidaito a duniya da kasawar cikin gida ta Afirka ba tare da nuna son rai ba.
about.027: >Dole ne suka ta kai ga sababbin hanyoyi, ƙirƙira da aiki.
about.029: >Ana fassara ra’ayoyin ilimi masu sarƙaƙiya zuwa harshen da kowa zai fahimta.
about.031: >Ba wai kawai abin da ya faru da Afirka ba, har ma abin da Afirka za ta iya dawowa da shi, ta sake ginawa kuma ta ƙirƙira yanzu.
about.034: >Dakta Damola masaniyar tattalin arzikin ci gaba ce, malama mai ɗora Afirka a tsakiya, ƙwararriya a fannoni da dama na AI, mai tsara dabarun manufofin gwamnati kuma mawaƙiyar waƙoƙin bishara, mai ƙwarewa ta fiye da shekaru 25 a gwamnati, jami’o’i da ba da shawara na ƙasa da ƙasa. Manufa, gaskiya da sauyi ne ke jagorantar aikinta, wanda ke a mahaɗar gyaran manufofi, tsarin ilimin da aka ’yanta daga mulkin mallaka, fasahar AI da ƙirƙira.
about.035: >A matsayinta na malama, bincikenta yana nazarin mulki mai ɗora Afirka a tsakiya, farfaɗowar Afirka da ’yantar da ilimi daga mulkin mallaka. Ita babbar mai bincike ce bayan digirin digirgir a Jami’ar Afirka ta Kudu (UNISA), inda take zurfafa aikinta kan tsarin ilimin gargajiya, ƙirƙira a manufofi da yadda sababbin fasahohi kamar AI za su iya sauya alkiblar ci gaban Afirka idan suka dogara da haƙiƙanin rayuwar gida, tana tambayar ba kawai abin da fasaha za ta iya yi ba, har ma wane take yi wa hidima da yadda ta dace da manufar farfaɗowar Afirka.
about.036: >Tafiyarta ta aiki ta haɗa da muƙamai a cibiyoyin ƙasa kamar Babban Bankin Najeriya da Hukumar Tara Haraji ta Najeriya. A matakin ƙasa da ƙasa, ta ba da shawara ga Bankin Duniya, UNDP, Tarayyar Turai da IFAD kan gyaran cibiyoyi, kimanta ci gaba da hanyoyin sauyin tattalin arziki masu tushe a al’adu.
about.037: >Ta wallafa ayyuka kuma ta gabatar da su a faɗin Afirka, Turai da Arewacin Amurka, kuma tana da digirin digirgir (PhD) a Nazarin Ci Gaba (UNISA), digiri na biyu (MSc) a Rage Talauci da Gudanar da Ci Gaba (Jami’ar Birmingham, Birtaniya) da digiri na farko (BSc) a Tattalin Arziki (Jami’ar Obafemi Awolowo, Najeriya). Ita ƙwararriya ce a Gudanar da Sauyi da Prosci® ta tabbatar, kuma mamba ce ta AIKRN, CITN, NIM, ANAN da NES.
about.038: >Bayan ilimi da manufofi, ita marubuciyar waƙoƙi ce kuma wadda ta kafa Oratorio Music Foundation (an kafa a 1996), wadda ta hanyarta ta ja-goranci matasa kuma ta jagoranci shirye-shiryen waƙoƙin bishara a jami’o’i. A matsayinta na ’yar shahararren ɗan wasan barkwanci na Najeriya Baba Sala, tana ci gaba da gadon iyali na ƙirƙira ta hanyar waƙa da barkwanci da ake fitarwa da sunan Oyindamola.
about.039: >A cikin duk abin da take yi, Dakta Damola tana neman ciyar da ilimi mai ɗora Afirka a tsakiya da amfani da AI da ke ƙalubalantar mahangar da ta mamaye; gyara tsare-tsaren gwamnati domin adalci, ɗaukar alhaki da ci gaban ƙasa; raya shugabanci mai ɗora Afirka a tsakiya wanda ke haɗa hikima, fasaha da ɗabi’un al’adu; da amfani da waƙa da ja-goranci don dawo da zukata ga Allah da ƙarfafa sauyi.
about.041: >Ba dandali ne da mutum ɗaya kawai ke magana ba
about.042: >Rethinking Africa al’umma ce mai bunƙasa ta malamai, ɗalibai, ƙwararru, masu fasaha, ’yan kasuwa, masu tsara manufofi, masu sana’a, dattawa, matasa da ’yan Afirka mazauna ƙetare.
about.043: >Ana gayyatarka ka ba da shawarar labari ko shiri, ka shiga hira, ka ba da tunani na bincike, ka ba da shawarar malami ko ƙwararre, ka raba ƙirƙirar al’umma, ka nuna ilimin Afirka da aka yi watsi da shi, ka ba da shawarar mafita ga ƙalubalen ci gaba, ko ka yi haɗin gwiwa a ayyukan bincike, yaɗa labarai da cuɗanya da jama’a.
about.044: >Ba da Gudunmawa Shiga al’umma

watch.014: >Gajerun bidiyoyi da aka gina a kan tambaya ɗaya da ba za ka iya mantawa da ita ba.

ideas.002: content="Maƙaloli, taƙaitattun bincike, jerin littattafan karatu da gajerun takardu daga Rethinking Africa with Dr. Damola."
ideas.004: alt="Tukunyar laka da aka sake hasashe a matsayin kimiyyar kayayyaki ta zamani"
ideas.007: >Ƙashin bayan rubutu na shirin. Wannan ne ya bambanta shi da tashoshin ra’ayi kawai.
ideas.009: >Daga Tukwanen Laka zuwa Makomar Quantum: Sake Tunani Game da Kimiyya, Ƙirƙira da Matsayin Afirka a Duniya
ideas.011: >Ilimin Afirka ba na kafin kimiyya ba ne; na kimiyya ne, na gwaji ne, bisa lura ne kuma mai sauyawa ne. Abin da ya dagula shi katsewa ce ta ƙarfi, ba kasawa ta cikin gida ba. Wannan takarda tana amfani da zane na hasashe da hotunan AI wajen kai kimiyyar gargajiya (ilimin sanyaya na tukunyar laka, lissafin lambobi biyu na Ifá, injiniyancin Great Zimbabwe, hanyoyin sadarwa na alamomin Aroko) zuwa makomar zamanin quantum, kuma ta gabatar da ƙa’idodi shida na tunanin kimiyya na Afirka.
ideas.013: >Abin da za ka samu a nan
ideas.015: >Nazari mai ɗora Afirka a tsakiya kan ilimi, aiki, mulki da al’adu.
ideas.017: >Muhimman sakamakon bincike na ilimi, da aka fassara zuwa ilimin jama’a mai sauƙin samu.
ideas.019: >Kowace madogarar da aka yi amfani da ita a cikin shiri, an jera ta domin masu kallo su tantance kuma su ƙara zurfafawa.
ideas.021: >Takardun bincike da manufofi masu shafi ɗaya ga malamai, jami’ai da ƙwararru.
ideas.022: >Malaman da aka gayyata suna ba da maƙaloli da sukar da ta dogara da hujja. Don ba da shawarar gudunmawa, ziyarci shafin Ba da Gudunmawa.
ideas.023: >Wallafe-wallafen farko suna zuwa tare da shirye-shiryen ƙaddamarwa
ideas.024: >Shiga jerin masu karɓar imel domin karɓar sababbin takardu da jerin karatu yayin da ake wallafa su.
publications.002: content="Maƙalolin da masana suka duba, littattafai da surorin littattafai na Dakta Oluwakemi Damola Adejumo-Ayibiowu kan mulki mai ɗora Afirka a tsakiya, ƙaura, ilimin gargajiya da ci gaban Afirka."
publications.005: >Binciken da masana suka duba kan mulki mai ɗora Afirka a tsakiya, ƙaura, ilimin gargajiya da ci gaban Afirka.
publications.007: >Sashen Nazarin Ci Gaba, Jami’ar Afirka ta Kudu. Don samun kwafin kowace maƙala da ba a buɗe ta ga kowa ba, rubuta zuwa research@rethinkingafrica.africa.
publications.043: >Kundin digirin digirgir, Jami’ar Afirka ta Kudu.
publications.053: >Ritimo.org, 15 ga Afrilu 2020. An wallafa da Faransanci.
publications.055: >Attac.no, 13 ga Fabrairu 2020. An wallafa da harshen Norway.
publications.057: >Ana maraba da malamai, ɗalibai da masu bincike su yi amfani da wannan aiki. Don jerin karatu, kayan koyarwa ko kwafin kowace maƙala, rubuto mana.
african-voices.001: <title>Muryoyin Afirka | Rethinking Africa with Dr. Damola</title>
african-voices.002: content="Fitattun muryoyin Afirka, tattaunawa a taruka da bangon al’umma a Rethinking Africa with Dr. Damola."
african-voices.006: >Malamai, masu sana’a, ɗalibai, ’yan kasuwa, dattawa, masu tsara manufofi da ’yan Afirka mazauna ƙetare. Dandalin teburi ne mai kujeru da yawa.
african-voices.008: >Kowane wata mutum ɗaya: malami, mai sana’a, ɗalibi, ɗan kasuwa, dattijo, mai tsara manufofi, ko wani daga ƙetare. Hoto, gajeren tarihin rayuwa, magana ɗaya da ya faɗa wadda ta zauna a ranmu, da wani yanki na tattaunawar.
african-voices.009: >Ba da shawarar wani
african-voices.011: >Hirarrakin da aka naɗa a taruka da haɗuwar jama’a, inda kowane baƙo ke amsa tambaya ɗaya da dole Afirka ta amsa.
african-voices.013: >Tattaunawar da aka naɗa tare da malamai da ƙwararru a Kanada.
african-voices.016: >Sababbin tarin tattaunawa a taruka za su bayyana a nan yayin da shirin ke tafiya.
african-voices.018: >Masu karatu suna amsa tambaya ɗaya kowane wata. Ana wallafa zaɓaɓɓun amsoshi a nan tare da izini, domin dandalin ya ɗauki fiye da murya ɗaya.
news.001: <title>Labarai da Taruka | Rethinking Africa with Dr. Damola</title>
news.002: content="Sanarwa, rubuce-rubucen blog da taruka daga Rethinking Africa with Dr. Damola."
news.006: >Sanarwa, tunani daga tafiye-tafiye, da tattaunawar da muka shiga a faɗin Afirka da ƙetare.
news.008: >Jerin Kwanaki 7 na Sake Tunani ya buɗe. Jerin imel kyauta yana karɓar masu rajista yanzu, kafin ƙaddamar da tashar. Yi gwajin domin shiga.
news.009: >Makon ƙaddamarwa yana zuwa. Shirye-shiryen farko na Rethinking Africa za su fito tare maimakon ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Za a sanar da kwanakin a nan da kuma ga jerin masu karɓar imel da farko.
news.011: >Tunani a rubuce tsakanin shirye-shirye: tunanin da ke bayan shirin, bayanai daga fage, da maƙalolin da ba su dace a cikin bidiyo ba. Rubuce-rubucen farko za su zo tare da ƙaddamarwa.
news.012: >Karɓe su ta imel
news.013: >Tarukan da muka halarta kuma muka shirya
news.014: >Taruka, tattaunawa a jami’o’i da muhawarar jama’a, an adana su domin al’umma ta bi tafiyar shirin. Hotuna da rahotannin kowane taro za su bayyana a nan.
news.015: >Duba tarin Tattaunawar Kanada
news.017: >Labarai, taruka da sababbin shirye-shirye suna zuwa ga jerin masu karɓar imel da farko.
contribute.006: >Ba da shawara, aika, ba da shawarar mutum, ƙalubalanta. Ana gina dandalin tare da al’ummarsa, ba wai kawai domin su ba.
contribute.009: >Wata lura mai ƙarfi, saɓani ko labarin ɗan Adam.
contribute.011: >Labarin kai da ke bayyana wata babbar tambaya ta Afirka.
contribute.013: >Masu bincike, masu sana’a, dattawa, jami’ai, matasa masu ƙirƙira.
contribute.015: >Rubutu bisa hujja, har da rashin jituwa mai gina wa.
contribute.017: >Kasuwanci, cibiyoyi ko al’adun da suka cancanci a adana su.
contribute.019: >Bincike, yin hira, shirya shirye-shirye, ko haɗin gwiwar cibiyoyi.
contribute.021: >Yi amfani da wannan fom maimakon saƙonni marasa tsari; yana taimaka wa ƙungiyar edita ta amsa kowace gudunmawa yadda ya kamata.
contribute.029: >Yi aikin sa-kai a matsayin mai bincike ko mai yin hira</option>
contribute.035: >Muna karanta kowace gudunmawa. Idan ta dace da shirin da ake yi ko wanda aka tsara, za mu rubuto maka. Hakan na iya ɗaukar ɗan lokaci, saboda ana karanta kowace da kyau maimakon na’ura ta ware su.
contribute.036: >Yayin da kake jira, gwajin zai gaya maka wane irin mai gina makomar Afirka kake, kuma ya fara jerin kwanaki bakwai kyauta.
contribute.037: >Yi gwajin Yi rajista a YouTube

policies.006: >Yadda wannan dandali ke kare masu ziyara, masu ba da gudunmawa da aikinsa.
policies.008: >Muna karɓar abin da fom ɗin rajista da na gudunmawa suka nema kawai (suna, imel, ƙasa da fannin da kake so) kuma muna amfani da shi ne kawai don aika jarida, amsa gudunmawa da inganta shirin. Ba ma sayarwa ko raba bayanan sirri. Za ka iya fita ko neman a share bayananka a kowane lokaci ta hanyar rubutawa zuwa drdamolaafrica@gmail.com.
policies.010: >Ana bayar da abubuwan da ke ciki domin ilimantar da jama’a. Masu ziyara na iya rabawa da ambaton abubuwa tare da ambaton tushe da hanyar haɗi. Aika gudunmawa yana ba shirin izinin duba ta; ba a wallafa komai ba tare da izinin mai ba da gudunmawar ba.
policies.012: >© Rethinking Africa with Dr. Damola. Shirye-shirye, maƙaloli, zane-zane da asalin shirin suna da kariya. Baƙi da masu ba da gudunmawa suna riƙe haƙƙi a kan kalmominsu da hotunansu; ana samun izinin hira da hoto kafin wallafawa, kuma kowane mahalarci na iya neman gyara ko cire gudunmawarsa.

editorial.002: content="Yadda Rethinking Africa ke tantance bincike, zaɓar madogara, gyara kurakurai da kare masu ba da gudunmawa."
editorial.006: >Dandalin yana tsakanin ilimi, aikin jarida, fina-finai masu bayani da ilimantar da jama’a. Waɗannan ƙa’idoji ne ke sa a amince da shi.
editorial.009: >Kafin wallafawa, ana goyon bayan maganganu da ingantaccen bincike, bayanan tarihi, alƙaluma, lura a fage ko shaidar al’umma.
editorial.011: >Muna fifita madogara na asali, ayyukan da masana suka duba da ƙwararrun da aka san sunansu, kuma muna bambanta gaskiya da fassara da hasashe a fili.
editorial.013: >Ana gyara kurakuran da aka tabbatar da sauri kuma a fili a shafin da abin ya shafa ko bayanin shirin. Za a iya neman gyara ta drdamolaafrica@gmail.com.
editorial.015: >Ana ambaton baƙi a cikin mahallin maganarsu, ana sanar da su yadda za a yi amfani da abubuwan, kuma za su iya duba hotunansu da maganganunsu da aka amince da su.
editorial.017: >Duk inda aka yi amfani da fasahar AI, sake kwaikwayo ko wasan kwaikwayo, ana bayyana hakan a cikin abin da kansa.
editorial.019: >Ana kula da labaran da aka aiko cikin sirri; ba a wallafa komai ba tare da izini ba, kuma ana kare asalin mutum idan ya nema.
editorial.021: >Manyan shirye-shirye suna ɗauke da madogaransu da jerin karatunsu a shafin Ra’ayoyi, domin masu kallo, ɗalibai da masu bincike su tantance madogarai kuma su ƙara zurfafawa.
